page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at the top. Below the running head, one text column with marginal notes in the left margin: "Aug." beside the italic quotation, "SECT. IV." beside section IV, and two reference notes with dagger-type marks ("f" and "t") beside the paragraph "I. Dicimus". No catchword and no signature.

main_text.p: “ detur mihi obex quidem esse remouendus, qui fructum le-ctionis eiusmodi vitarum impedire facilè posset. Dicent “ enim Christiani Principes, superuacaneum videri, velle “ cognoscere quid in Repub. Hebraica Testamenti veteris egerint Principes, siue Reges, quùm nos ad Remp. noui Testamenti, per Dei gratiam, pertineamus. Sed hic obex facilè “ remoueri potest; docet enim S. AugustinusAug. in epist. ad Honoratum, de gratia noui Testamenti, & alibi frequenter, “ sanctos viros Testamenti veteris, quales imprimis fuerint “ sancti Principes Moses, Iosua, Dauid, & aly, floruisse “ quidem tempore Testamenti veteris, sed reuerà pertinuisse “ ad Testamentum nouum; nempe quatenus bona temporalia “ contemnentes spiritualibus inhærebant. Eiusmodi fuisse “ sanctos Principes veteris Testamenti, quorum vitas legen-dæ[?] proponimus, usque adeo verum est, ut rarissimi Christiani Principes inveniantur, qui veteribus illis in virtu-tibus & vitæ sanctitate non cedant. Hæc Bellarminus. Hoc igitur obice, vt ais, remoto, facilior de reliquis differendi Ratio nobis proponitur: hoc enim iam Nobis incumbit, ut Reges in veteri Testamento Sacerdotibus imperasse probemus.
main_text.head: II. ANIMADVERSIO. Mosen, & Iosuam, quâ Principes, Sacerdotibus præfuisse.
main_text.p: SECT. IV.HOc vel quadruplici Exemplorum Collatione facilè effectum dabimus; I. inter Mosen Principem, & Aaronem Sacerdotem: II. inter Iosuam, & Eleazarum: III. inter Salomonem, & Abiatharum: IV. inter Iosiam, & Sacerdotum tribum instituitur; de quibusfingulis comminus disceptabimus.

I. Dicimus Mosen praefuisse Aaroni: Respondet Sanderus,Sanderus qua supra. {f}Hoc inepte obiici, quia Moses erat Sacerdos, testante Dauid, Psal 98. Moses & Aaron in Sacerdotibus eius. Argutè; quasi verò Moses non (ipso testante Bellarmino){t}Bellarm.lib.3.de verbo Dei cap.4. Simul Princeps & Pontifex fuerit; qui licet docendi, sa- crifi-

page.notes: Two marginal notes are reference marks: the left "f" and "t" notes, and the in-text marks {f} and {t}, are read from the scan and may be slightly off. The word "legendæ" after "legen-" is doubtful. The "Ho-/noratum" hyphenation and the accent on "norátum" and "imperásse" are doubtful. The line "fa-" / "crifi-" at the foot: the first syllable is read as "sa-" (long s), so the word is probably "sacrificandi"; it is marked as doubtful. "Cap.5" is kept as part of the running head. The line "quibusfingulis" is printed without a space and is left as printed.
